briefing.summary: On ILS RWY 35 at Canberra. At the minimum altitude you can't acquire the runway environment. Commit to the missed approach now.

challenge.prompt: Make the call to Tower announcing the missed approach.

elements.label: Going-around phrase
elements.hint: Standard AIP ENR 1.5 phrase. Not 'missed approach' on its own — 'going around' is the immediate announcement.

challenge.explanation: AIP ENR 1.5 + MATS Part 4: keep the missed-approach announcement minimal — 'going around' plus callsign. Tower is already expecting it as a possibility and needs to issue follow-up instructions immediately.
